drugs.title: Drug reference
drugs.search: Search by English name, Arabic name or active ingredient
drugs.drugsOnly: Medicines only (hide cosmetics and care products)
drugs.priceNote: Prices are reference prices from the imported file, not binding sale prices. Check the date of your source file.
drugs.alternatives.note: Suggestions only: same active ingredients, same strength read from the name, same route. A pharmacist must verify before substituting.
drugs.alternatives.none: No alternatives suggested (active ingredient or strength could not be determined, or no match).

drugs.import.failed: Import failed. Check the file and try again.

inventory.adjust.hint: Use a negative number to remove stock (damage, loss, count difference). A reason is required and is recorded.
inventory.noWarehouse: No warehouse is available for your account.
inventory.err.pickProduct: Pick a product from the list first.
inventory.err.dates: Production date must be before the expiry date.
inventory.err.qty: Quantity must be greater than zero.
inventory.err.delta: Enter a non-zero quantity change and a reason.
inventory.err.negative: This would make the batch quantity negative.
inventory.err.notFound: Warehouse, product or batch was not found.
inventory.err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
